name: Issue-to-Fix (Limitation of Liability)
source_contract: Corio / Commerce One ASP agreement (SEC EDGAR), parties retained
provenance: REAL-QUOTED clause + constructed key; the 'uncapped Section 8 indemnification' diagnosis is authored legal judgment (provisional).

criteria.criterion: No fabricated additional problems: every problem asserted is present in the shown clause
The cap and the consequential-damages exclusion are quoted/paraphrased accurately
The Step-1 analysis argues from Commerce One's (Vendor's) seat throughout
The rewrite reduces or holds Vendor's net exposure (caps §8; does not raise, remove, or carve categories out of the cap)
Identifies §8 indemnification is carved out of the consequential-damages exclusion (uncapped IP liability outside the cap) and the fix caps it
Notes the cap is 'amounts paid by Corio' so early in the contract Vendor's recoverable damages approach zero
Recognizes the consequential-damages exclusion is well-drafted and NOT the problem
The rewrite actually closes the §8 gap (enforceable, addresses the risk)
Supplies usable clause language for the rewrite, not a description

trips_on: Inventing an additional problem not present in the shown clause
Misquoting the cap or consequential-damages exclusion language
Asserting a cap figure or §8 content not shown
does_not_trip_on: A true outside-knowledge statement not misattributed to the clause
Acknowledging §8 is referenced but not shown

trips_on: The rewrite RAISES or REMOVES the cap (e.g. a 'greater of' floor pegged to Corio's damages)
The rewrite carves §8 (or other categories) OUT of the cap (uncapped exposure)
The Step-1 analysis reasons from Corio's (Customer's) recovery perspective
does_not_trip_on: Noting the early-term cap issue from Vendor's seat

rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — C2 (Issue-to-Fix (Limitation of Liability)) · Max /16 · Gates: Faithfulness + Directionality
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Real quoted limitation-of-liability clause (Corio / Commerce One); Section 8 is referenced by the carve-out but not shown — the gold is inferable from the carve-out alone; do not require or invent Section 8's text.
SEAT: You represent Commerce One (Vendor); the fix must protect Vendor.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] No fabricated additional problems: every problem asserted is present in the shown clause; [critical] The cap and the consequential-damages exclusion are quoted/paraphrased accurately. TRIPS ONLY ON: Inventing an additional problem not present in the shown clause; Misquoting the cap or consequential-damages exclusion language; Asserting a cap figure or §8 content not shown. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A true outside-knowledge statement not misattributed to the clause; A defensible flagged concern; Acknowledging §8 is referenced but not shown.
DIRECTIONALITY /4 (GATE): criteria — [critical] The Step-1 analysis argues from Commerce One's (Vendor's) seat throughout; [critical] The rewrite reduces or holds Vendor's net exposure (caps §8; does not raise, remove, or carve categories out of the cap). TRIPS ONLY ON: The rewrite RAISES or REMOVES the cap (e.g. a 'greater of' floor pegged to Corio's damages); The rewrite carves §8 (or other categories) OUT of the cap (uncapped exposure); The Step-1 analysis reasons from Corio's (Customer's) recovery perspective. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Capping §8 indemnification (the required fix); Adding a Vendor-favorable carve-in/sublimit; Noting the early-term cap issue from Vendor's seat.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, C2.issue.uncapped_indemnity] Identifies §8 indemnification is carved out of the consequential-damages exclusion (uncapped IP liability outside the cap) and the fix caps it; [major, C2.issue.early_term_cap] Notes the cap is 'amounts paid by Corio' so early in the contract Vendor's recoverable damages approach zero.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Recognizes the consequential-damages exclusion is well-drafted and NOT the problem; [critical] The rewrite actually closes the §8 gap (enforceable, addresses the risk); [minor] Symmetry fix to §8.2 — optional, creditable.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Supplies usable clause language for the rewrite, not a description.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
VARIANTS / CLEAN INSTANCE: OPEN ('any problems … if any', headline) + DIRECTED (points at the carve-out). CLEAN INSTANCE: well-drafted cap → gold = 'no material problem'; a manufactured defect stated as fact trips Faithfulness.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /16 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
